description: Storytelling, Advertisement, Social media viral content, Video scripts, Poster/campaign concepts

questions.badPrompt: Write an ad for our college fest.
questions.context: An upcoming 3-day inter-college technical and cultural festival.
missingElements: Target audience demographics (age, student interests)
Tone and brand personality (youthful, energetic, cyberpunk)
Platform format (video script, Instagram reel, poster copy)
Key attractions and call to action (dates, website, registration link)
Constraints (duration, character limit, scene directions)

questions.badPrompt: Write a story about an AI taking over a coffee shop.
questions.context: A sci-fi comedy short narrative.
missingElements: Main characters & protagonist perspective (barista vs robotic manager)
Pacing and narrative arc (inciting incident, climax, humorous resolution)
Humor style and dialogue formatting
Word limit and scene formatting specifications

questions.badPrompt: Create a social media video about plastic pollution.
questions.context: A viral public-awareness campaign for Gen Z audiences on Instagram and TikTok.
missingElements: Hook within the first 3 seconds to prevent drop-off
Visual storytelling scene transitions and camera angles
BGM and sound design cues
Actionable consumer lifestyle change CTA

questions.badPrompt: Write a sci-fi movie trailer voiceover.
questions.context: A dramatic theatrical trailer for a post-apocalyptic solar flare survival thriller.
missingElements: Pacing milestones (0-15s Tease, 15-45s Escalation, 45-60s Climax)
Cinematic SFX and orchestral cue markers [BASS DROP, GLITCH]
Deep, gravelly narrator voice persona guidelines
Final title card lockup and release date reveal

questions.badPrompt: Design an Instagram carousel for a new fitness sneaker.
questions.context: A product reveal campaign for an ultra-lightweight running shoe made from recycled ocean plastics.
missingElements: 5-to-7 slide breakdown with slide-by-slide visual layout
Catchy headline copy per slide with hook & retention strategy
Visual aesthetic direction (color palette, photography style, typography)
Clear swipe CTA and conversion link in bio trigger

questions.badPrompt: Write a funny script for a commercial about bad WiFi.
questions.context: A 30-second TV & YouTube pre-roll ad promoting high-speed fiber internet.
missingElements: Two contrasting characters experiencing high-stakes video call embarrassment
Specific audio/visual gag cues and timing breakdown (0-10s, 10-20s, 20-30s)
Brand tagline integration and visual logo outro
Relatable work-from-home or gaming crisis scenario

questions.badPrompt: Write a poem about space exploration.
questions.context: A commemorative spoken-word piece for an interstellar rover landing on an exoplanet.
missingElements: Poetic form and rhythm (free verse vs rhymed meter, cadence)
Emotional tone (wonder, existential isolation, human triumph)
Specific cosmic imagery (nebulae, gravitational waves, telemetry signals)
Length constraints (stanzas, lines, spoken duration)

questions.badPrompt: Make a podcast intro for a true crime show.
questions.context: An atmospheric opening audio sequence for an investigative podcast focusing on unsolved cyber heists.
missingElements: Host persona, tone, and pacing (suspenseful, measured, gritty)
Sound effects cues (typing clicks, dial-up static, ominous cello drone)
Episode tease hook and thematic signature tagline
Show credits and sponsor mention placement

questions.badPrompt: Write a rap battle between Isaac Newton and Albert Einstein.
questions.context: An educational entertainment YouTube video script in the style of Epic Rap Battles.
missingElements: Rhyme scheme, bar count per verse, and beat tempo (BPM)
Scientific references and witty historical disses (calculus, relativity, apples)
Stage presence directions and beat switch transitions
Scoring / closing punchline challenge for the audience

questions.badPrompt: Write a hero backstory for a cyberpunk video game.
questions.context: Character bio and origin vignette for an augmented street medic turned hacker.
missingElements: Core internal motivation, fatal flaw, and unique cybernetic ability
Dystopian worldbuilding context (megacorporation antagonist, neon slums)
Inciting tragic incident that caused them to go rogue
Formatting (Character Sheet: Stats, Lore, Dialogue sample)

questions.badPrompt: Create a tagline and slogan for a luxury chocolate brand.
questions.context: Rebranding an artisanal Swiss dark chocolate company emphasizing ethical single-origin cocoa.
missingElements: Target consumer demographic (gourmet foodies, luxury gifting)
Tone and brand personality (sophisticated, sensual, sustainable)
Variations (short 3-word punchy slogan vs evocative packaging copy)
Competitor differentiation from mass-market brands

questions.badPrompt: Write a comic book scene where two superheroes argue.
questions.context: A 4-page comic script depicting ideological conflict between a vigilante tech-detective and a cosmic protector.
missingElements: Page-by-page and panel-by-panel script breakdown (Panel 1, Panel 2...)
Visual descriptions for artist (angles, lighting, facial expressions)
Dialogue bubbles, captions, and SFX lettering instructions
Escalating philosophical tension before a plot-interrupting crisis

questions.badPrompt: Write a catchy jingle for an electric toothbrush.
questions.context: A 15-second radio and Spotify audio ad featuring an ultra-sonic smart toothbrush with gum tracking.
missingElements: Musical genre, tempo, and vocal style (upbeat pop, rhythmic chant)
Key product benefit highlights (30-day battery, plaque removal, sonic speed)
Audio cues and sound effects (sparkle ping, whirring buzz)
Memorable rhyming hook with brand name repetition

questions.badPrompt: Write a spooky campfire story for teenagers.
questions.context: A suspenseful urban legend narrative set in an abandoned smart-house in the woods.
missingElements: Foreshadowing, rising dread, and auditory sensory details
Pacing instructions for the storyteller (pauses, whispered lines)
Unexpected twist ending rather than generic monster tropes
Target length and reading duration (3-4 minutes)

questions.badPrompt: Write an elevator pitch script for a fantasy novel.
questions.context: A 60-second verbal pitch to literary agents for a high-fantasy heist novel.
missingElements: Logline formula (Protagonist + Inciting Incident + Stakes + Unique Hook)
Comp titles ('Ocean\'s Eleven meets Mistborn')
Target market, reader demographic, and world magic system USP
Clear call to action for manuscript submission

questions.badPrompt: Create a viral TikTok video concept for a book launch.
questions.context: A BookTok video promoting an enemies-to-lovers dark academia thriller.
missingElements: Trending audio suggestion, on-screen text hook (POV format)
Fast-paced visual aesthetic moodboard (candles, old library, rainy window)
Curiosity gap question in caption to drive comments and shares
Video duration (12-15 seconds) and hashtags

questions.badPrompt: Write a monologue for a villain who thinks they are doing good.
questions.context: A theatrical monologue for a rogue geneticist eliminating human fear to prevent wars.
missingElements: Philosophical justification, internal anguish, and cold rational logic
Stage movement, vocal dynamics (whisper to crescendo), and breathing marks
Props interaction and dramatic lighting cues
Target length (60-90 seconds) and character objective

questions.badPrompt: Write copy for a billboard on a busy highway.
questions.context: Outdoor advertising for a sleep-tracker smartwatch targeting stressed commuter drivers.
missingElements: Maximum 7-word headline constraint for 60mph visibility
High-contrast visual layout description and typography hierarchy
Emotional trigger (fatigue awareness vs energy boost)
Simple, memorable URL or QR code placement directive

questions.badPrompt: Create a quest briefing for an RPG game.
questions.context: An in-game dialogue dialogue quest given by a mysterious tavern bartender in a steampunk city.
missingElements: NPC voice dialect and personality quirks
Clear quest objectives, optional bonus conditions, and danger warnings
Branching dialogue choices (Aggressive, Inquisitive, Greedy)
Explicit reward breakdown (Gold, XP, Steampunk grappling hook)

questions.badPrompt: Write a launch email for a designer clothing drop.
questions.context: An exclusive VIP streetwear capsule collection with only 100 numbered pieces.
missingElements: Subject line with high FOMO and urgency trigger
Visual design layout (hero image, product showcase, scarcity counter)
Brand voice (minimalist, rebellious, premium)
Direct checkout CTA button and drop unlock countdown timer

questions.badPrompt: Write a children's story about a dragon who loves baking.
questions.context: An illustrated bedtime picture book for children aged 4-7.
missingElements: Rhythmic and alliterative language suitable for reading aloud
Page-by-page layout (Spread 1 to Spread 12) with illustration descriptions
Relatable moral lesson on embracing unusual passions and sharing
Gentle, cozy vocabulary and wholesome conflict resolution

questions.badPrompt: Write a speech for a college graduation valedictorian.
questions.context: A 5-minute commencement speech for a graduating class entering the AI and remote-work era.
missingElements: Speech structure (Humorous opening hook, shared memory, poignant challenge, visionary call to action)
Delivery cadence markers ([PAUSE FOR LAUGHTER], [EMPHASIZE])
Universal emotional themes balancing resilience with optimism
Memorable closing punchline

questions.badPrompt: Create an immersive worldbuilding guide for a floating island city.
questions.context: Setting guide for an aerial fantasy realm powered by gravity crystals.
missingElements: Structured lore categories (Geography, Architecture, Economy, Social Classes, Defense)
Sensory environmental details (wind currents, altitude sickness, sky-docking)
Central cultural conflict and resource scarcity point
Markdown formatting with bulleted dossier structure

questions.badPrompt: Write a menu description for a futuristic cyberpunk restaurant.
questions.context: A high-end dining menu in Neo-Tokyo featuring synthetic gastronomy and neon molecular drinks.
missingElements: 3 distinct course categories (Synth-Appetizers, Quantum Mains, Cyber-Cocktails)
Sensory culinary adjectives blended with sci-fi ingredients (hydro-grown kelp, bioluminescent caviar)
Atmospheric menu styling and price format (in Cyber-Credits ₵)
Humorous warning disclaimers for cybernetic-enhanced diners

questions.badPrompt: Write a movie scene where a detective realizes who the killer is.
questions.context: A tense neo-noir thriller climax in a rain-soaked archive room.
missingElements: Industry standard screenplay formatting (SCENE HEADING, ACTION, CHARACTER, PARENTHETICAL, DIALOGUE)
Visual clue discovery trigger and internal epiphany realization cues
Camera choreography (extreme close-up on eyes, rack focus to door)
Pacing tension build leading to an immediate life-or-death cliffhanger
